name: ZSP_BR_BINDINGS
description: This table is to store the bindings of a rule.

columns.name: BINDING_ID
columns.description: the primary key for a binding that is generated by middletier sequence generator

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: the id of the rule that this binding is for

columns.name: IN_LHS_FLAG
columns.description: 1 iff if the binding is in the left-hand side of the rule, otherwise 0

columns.name: REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: 1 iff if the binding is required for this the rule, otherwise 0

columns.name: VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: 1 iff if the binding is visible for this the rule, otherwise 0

columns.name: POSITION
columns.description: the 0-based position relative to the parent binding

columns.name: PARENT_BINDING_ID
columns.description: the id of the parent binding, if any

columns.name: BINDING_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: one of 'Entity', 'Function', 'Attribute', 'Boolean', 'Byte', 'Short', 'Integer', 'Long', 'Float', 'Double', 'String', 'BigDecimal', 'Date', 'Time', or 'Timestamp'

columns.name: QUANTIFICATION_NAME
columns.description: one of 'ForEach', 'Some', or 'None' if it is an entity binding

columns.name: ENTITY_GUID
columns.description: The Guid of the entity that corresponds to this binding if the type is 'Entity'.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: the id of the entity that corresponds to this binding if the type is 'Entity'

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_GUID
columns.description: The Guid of the attribute that corresponds to this binding if the type is 'Attribute'.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: the id of the attribute that corresponds to this binding if the type is 'Attribute'

columns.name: REFERENCE_BINDING_ID
columns.description: the id of the reference binding, if any. RHS attribute bindings can make reference to a function, another binding or a constant

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: the id of the action that corresponds to this binding if the type is 'Action'

columns.name: ACTION_ARG_ID
columns.description: the id of the action argument that corresponds to this binding if the type is 'ActionArgument'

columns.name: INVERT_FUNCTION_FLAG
columns.description: 1 iff if the function binding should be inverted.  the flag is null only if the binding is not a function binding

columns.name: FUNCTION_ID
columns.description: the id of the function that corresponds to this binding if the type is 'Function'

columns.name: FUNCTION_ARG_ID
columns.description: the id of the function argument that corresponds to this binding if the type is 'function argument'

columns.name: BINDING_VALUE
columns.description: the constant value for a binding

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
